{{Top|leg}}
An '''acoustic disrupter''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool used by the guards in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The disrupter sloughed rocks layers off of mining tunnel walls to expose layers of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]].
